prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game character animation sprite sheet for an orthographic fantasy RPG.
Input image: reference image ONLY for the warm fantasy palette and the gentle anime/chibi character style. Do NOT reproduce the village, UI, flowers, other people, or objects.
Primary request: create ONE transparent sprite sheet containing the SAME simple young adventurer in exactly 16 frames arranged in a precise 4 columns by 4 rows regular grid, square overall canvas. Every grid cell is exactly one quarter of the image width/height, with one complete isolated full-body character centered in it. Identical scale and fixed foot baseline within every cell, ample transparent padding all around. No cropped hair or feet, no overlap across cells.
Character: small approachable anime-inspired fantasy adventurer, tousled chestnut brown hair, big simple expressive dark eyes, teal short tunic over cream sleeves, small ochre neck scarf, brown belt, dark trousers and simple brown ankle boots. No weapons, no accessories dangling far outside the silhouette. Clean readable silhouette, about 3 heads tall. Slightly elevated 3/4 RPG view, not a 3D block model; crisp hand-painted 2D game sprite rendering with restrained linework, simple cel shading, modest detail.
Rows from top to bottom:
row 1: faces screen down / front view (face visible).
row 2: faces screen left / left 3/4 side view.
row 3: faces screen right / right 3/4 side view.
row 4: faces screen up / back view (back of hair visible, NO face).
Columns left to right in EVERY row: walk cycle pose 1 left foot forward, pose 2 passing feet together, pose 3 right foot forward, pose 4 opposite passing feet together. Counter-swing arms gently. All 4 frames must preserve the exact same character identity and proportions. This is a real looping walk sprite sheet, with genuine alternating leg/arm poses, not sixteen identical standing pictures.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background, no ground, no shadows, no text, no labels, no visible grid lines, no checkerboard painted into the pixels, no scenery. Precisely 4 rows by 4 columns; no extra characters or rows. Render at useful high resolution so individual cells can be sampled as a texture atlas.
selection_note: Use front, right and back rows. Left mirrors right because one generated left-facing row frame turns the wrong way. Preserve the original image; atlas selection belongs in the manifest.
